audio.t: Attention, all seniors. The Registrar's Office will hold graduation check sessions next Tuesday and Wednesday from ten a.m. to four p.m. in the lobby of the Administration Building. Advisors will review your credits one on one and tell you exactly what is still missing before spring course registration opens on November twenty-third. Please print your graduation audit from the student portal and bring it with you. No appointment is necessary.

questions.explain: 廣播說 Please print your graduation audit ... and bring it with you，故選 C。廣播明說不需預約，B 錯；學生證與選課單都沒有提到。
options: Their student ID card
An appointment confirmation
A printed copy of their graduation audit
Their course registration form

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. I'm Professor Wang, and I advise fourth-year students in the Department of Business Administration. Since spring registration opens in just a few weeks, I want to go over the three things that most often stop students from graduating on time.

The first is general education. You need thirty credits in total, but they must come from at least four of the five areas. Every year, a few students have plenty of credits, but all in the same area, so please check the distribution, not just the number. The second is the English requirement. You can meet it with an approved test score, or by passing two English-taught courses in our department. If you choose the test, give yourself time, because scores can take about a month to arrive.

The third is physical education. Many of you forget that the two P E credits from your first year are required, and they don't count toward your total of one hundred twenty-eight. If anything on your audit looks wrong, email me before November twentieth, not during finals.

questions.explain: 講者開頭說要說明最常讓學生無法準時畢業的三件事，故選 C。規定本身沒有改變；英語授課與體育只是其中的提醒項目。

To recruit students for English-taught courses

head: From: Registrar's Office
To: All Seniors
Subject: Your graduation audit and correction deadline
passage: Your preliminary graduation audit is now available on the student portal. It shows the credits you have completed, the courses you are taking this semester, and any requirements that are still unmet. Please review it carefully, as it will be used to determine your eligibility to graduate in June 2027.

If you find an error, such as a course listed in the wrong category or a missing transfer credit, submit a correction request through the portal by November 27. Requests must include supporting documents, for example an approval form signed by your department. After this date, corrections can be made only in **exceptional** cases, such as a system error.
Please note that students who expect to finish their final requirement during the summer session must also apply for August graduation by March 15.

questions.explain: 信中說明初步畢業檢核已上線，請學生仔細檢查並在 11 月 27 日前申請更正，故選 B。典禮日期、暑修選課與費用都沒有提到。
options: To announce the date of the graduation ceremony
To ask seniors to review their audit and report any errors
To explain how to register for summer courses
To remind students to pay graduation fees
questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

questions.explain: 後文舉例 such as a system error，指「特殊、例外的」情況，故選 unusual。exceptional 也可表示「傑出的」，excellent 正是這個字義陷阱；ordinary 意思相反。
options: excellent
expensive
unusual
ordinary
questions.prompt: The word "exceptional" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

options: Submit a correction request by November 27
Get a form signed by the department
Take a summer course at another university

passage: At many Taiwanese universities, staying an extra semester or two has become almost normal. At our university, only 71 percent of last year's seniors graduated within four years, down from 80 percent a decade ago, according to the Office of Academic Affairs.

Some delays are planned. Students who go on exchange, take long internships, or add a double major often choose to stay longer. Others, however, are caught by surprise. "I found out in my last semester that two of my general education courses were in the same area," said Lin Wei-chen, a fifth-year student in journalism. "I had enough credits, but not the right ones." Missing English scores and forgotten PE credits are other common reasons.

There is also a practical side. Some students delay graduation on purpose to keep their student status, which allows them to apply for internships open only to current students or to postpone military service. Each extra semester, however, means more tuition, and the university has less space for incoming students.

To reduce unplanned delays, the university will launch an online tool called GradPath next semester. Unlike the current audit, which is updated only twice a year, GradPath will update every time a new grade is posted and will warn students if they fall behind in any requirement. Advisors will also be able to see their students' progress and contact those at risk.

Not everyone thinks technology is the answer. "A dashboard can show what's missing, but it can't tell you why you should take a course," said Professor Chou Hsiu-ling, who chairs the curriculum committee. She hopes students will still meet their advisors at least once a year.

questions.explain: 全文說明延畢比例上升的原因，並介紹 GradPath 新工具與不同看法，故選 B。雙主修與兵役只是文中提到的細節。
options: How to apply for a double major
Why more students take longer to graduate, and a new tool to help
The history of general education courses
Changes to military service rules
